Women's Vayishlach Class - Are You Living on Your Own Energy or Borrowing Someone Else’s?
blurb: Yaakov and Esav Reveal Two Radically Different Ways of Experiencing Life When Yaakov and Esav reunite after twenty years, two seemingly similar expressions reveal two radically different experiences of existence. Esav declares, יש לי רב—I have plenty. Yaakov declares, יש לי כל—I have everything. How could Yaakov make such an audacious statement? His life was hardly devoid of pain, loss, or unfulfilled needs. And how can we proclaim daily in Grace After Meals, דורשי ה' לא יחסרו כל טוב, that those who seek Hashem lack nothing good? In a breathtaking insight, the Sfas Emes opens an entirely new understanding of abundance. When you connect to the infinite divine spark that constitutes the inner essence of all reality, you are touching everything. Just as the genetic blueprint of an entire organism is contained within a single nucleated cell, the infinite is present within every fragment of existence. Yaakov was not merely declaring his satisfaction with what he possessed; he was expressing his intimate attachment to the source of all existence. This class explores the profound psychological and spiritual difference between living in authentic self-energy and constantly seeking external sources of energy to fill an internal void. We can spend our lives pursuing relationships, wealth, pleasure, recognition, entertainment, and success, yet remain haunted by an inexplicable emptiness.
